Anarul Islam alias Md. Anurul Islam
Vs.
The State
full_judgment:
66. Presumption and determination of age:-(1) Whenever a person, whether charged with an offence or not brought before any criminal Court otherwise than for the purpose of giving evidence, and it appears to the Court that he is a child, the Court shall make an inquiry as to the age of that person and, for that purpose shall take such evidence as may be forth coming at the hearing of the cases, and shall record a finding thereon, stating his age as nearly as may be. 

 9. It appears from sub-section (I) of section 66 that the legislature in its wisdom, used the expression in the said sub-section to the effect,------ and it appears to the court ------" Leaving it to the discretion of the Court to make a presumption as to the age of accused on his physical appearance, who is standing on the dock before him and can see the accused with his own eyes, so that he needs no evidence. He can deal with it.
